verdict.decisive_criterion: bootstrap CI on mean paired difference excludes 0 and |d_z| > 1
verdict.note: Comparisons are paired at the seed level, because perturbations within a seed share one fitted model and are not independent. With 5 seeds no comparison can reach p < 0.05, so a difference is called decisive only when its CI excludes zero and the effect size is large; everything else is reported as no reliable difference rather than as a null result. Rank correlations are computed only where a split has at least 5 test perturbations. Any readout listed under unreliable_readouts is one where the latent oracle did not rank in the top two, meaning that readout cannot score reversal faithfully and its ranking numbers should not be used as evidence.
